title: Setup
description:
## Welcome to learn Linux!
In this course, you will be taught from the basics, all the way up to advanced `.sh` creation. In this course, you will be working for a ficticious banking company, "City bank"
---
Now, to use linux, first you need to have it. If you already are using Linux, or MacOS, no need to do this step, but if you are on Windows, you need to get somthing called _**Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)**_. This program allows you to use a linux shell on Windows!
---
### Installing WSL:
Simply, open a administrator powershell, then run `wsl --install`. Be ready as it will take a while. After, restart your computer. After it is instaled, you may run WSL by just searching WSL, and clicking on it to open it. To make sure you have the right distro, run cat /etc/os-release and make sure it says Ubuntu.
---
Now that you have linux, you need to install the LearnHardCode CLI. This is how you will submit lessons to the course. You must go to the link [here](https://github.com/Youg-Otricked/learnhardcode-cli_and_cli-courses/releases/tag/V1.0.0), install the binary, then once you get the file, open your teminal and type these commands exactly:
### Linux/MacOS Users:
Open your terminal and type:
```
cd ~/Downloads
chmod +x ./lhc
sudo ./lhc setup your_username
```

### Windows (WSL) Users:
Open WSL and type:
```
cd /mnt/c/Users/YOUR_USERNAME/Downloads
chmod +x ./lhc
sudo ./lhc setup your_username
```
Replace YOUR_USERNAME with your Windows/MacOS/Linux username, and enter your sudo password (your device password on mac/linux or the password you chose at setup on windows).

---
Then everyone, close and reopen your terminal and type:
```
lhc help
```
If you see a list of commands, run `lhc upgrade`. Now you're ready!
---
Press the submit button to continue
